name: Wadisuchus
sum: Wadisuchus is an early long-snouted dyrosaurid from the Middle Campanian El Hindaw Member of the Quseir Formation, Egypt.
wsnote: About 3.51 m long and 199.75-265.15 kg for the holotype, estimated from head width (English Wikipedia).
holotype: MUVP 180, the better preserved of two nearly complete skulls.
biology: May have been a fish-eating specialist (English Wikipedia).
author: Saber et al. 2025

sources.text: Saber, S., Salem, B. S., Ouda, K., Gohar, A. S., El-Sayed, S., O'Connor, P. M. and Sallam, H. M. 2025. An early dyrosaurid (Wadisuchus kassabi gen. et sp. nov.) from the Campanian of Egypt sheds light on the origin and biogeography of Dyrosauridae. Zoological Journal of the Linnean Society 205(2).

dates_note: No PBDB occurrences. Middle Campanian per English Wikipedia; whole ICS stage used.
